content:
OpenAI put a five-year Shopify veteran in charge of their commerce platform. Three months later, everything changed.

In this issue

  • Discovery Works. Checkout Doesn't. Yet. Users were researching products in ChatGPT. Comparing options.
  • Where Things Stand. Shopify president Harley Finkelstein said at the Morgan Stanley TMT Conference that only about a dozen of Shopify's millions of merchants were currently selling through AI tools.
  • Is Shopify Winning the Agentic Commerce Battle? Coates spent five years building the plumbing at Shopify.
  • The Shopware Counterargument. The walled garden failed because merchants and consumers didn't trust a third party with checkout.
  • Where Does Commerce.com Fit? The pullback created a pause in the market. Some companies used that time to build.
  • The Agentic Commerce Protocol Survives. The in-chat checkout is effectively dead. But the standards work that powered it isn't.
  • The Amazon Angle. While Coates is rebuilding OpenAI's commerce approach from the app layer up, Amazon looked at the same opportunity and made a completely different bet.
